test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 25 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: If the GST on a certain article was Rs.600 two years back and it increased to Rs.750 this year, find the percentage increase in the GST on that article.
solution:
**Given:**

GST two years back = ₹600

GST this year = ₹750

**Formula used:**

Percentage Increase = dfrac{{New Value} - {Old Value}}{{Old Value}} times 100

**Calculation:**

Percentage Increase = dfrac{750 - 600}{600} times 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = dfrac{150}{600} times 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = dfrac{1}{4} times 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
